root_cause_and_implementation: Minimum change following the C2 contract table: replayAdmissibility() (already the authoritative pre-comparison gate producing NOT_ADMISSIBLE/BLOCKED for a self-generated fixture, an unbound configuration, or an unverified bound-input context -- all three already existing, none touched) gained one further, structurally identical check, placed first: if $fixture['expected_proof_missing'] is non-empty, return a reason naming every missing path with the REPLAY_EXPECTED_PROOF_INCOMPLETE prefix. verifyRunAgainstFixture()'s existing admissibility-override block (unmodified) then sets replay_status=BLOCKED and comparison_result=NOT_ADMISSIBLE exactly as it already does for the other two conditions -- no new status vocabulary was invented; Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md's own BLOCKED definition already reads 'fixture/runtime/input proof', so extending the existing mechanism to the fixture-incompleteness case is the literal contract text, not an interpretation. compareExpectedAndActual() itself was not changed: it still folds expected_proof_missing entries into its own mismatches list via appendMismatch() (field=expected_proof.<path>, reason=REPLAY_EXPECTED_PROOF_INCOMPLETE), and that list is never cleared by the admissibility override (confirmed by reading verifyRunAgainstFixture()'s final return, which passes through $comparison['mismatches']/['mismatch_reason_codes'] unmodified) -- so the exact missing path remains visible in evidence (mismatch_summary and the raw mismatches/mismatch_reason_codes_json) even though the outer verdict is now BLOCKED, not FAIL. ReplayResultRepository was read (not modified): comparison_result/replay_status are persisted as plain string columns already capable of carrying NOT_ADMISSIBLE/BLOCKED, proven by the two pre-existing admissibility tests (bound-context-unavailable cases) that already exercise this exact persistence path -- no repository change was needed or made. One pre-existing test asserting the defective behavior (test_verify_replay_fails_safe_when_expected_proof_is_incomplete) was corrected in place, not silently left red or deleted: its Mockery matcher and final assertions now require NOT_ADMISSIBLE/BLOCKED, and a new assertion on the raw mismatches array confirms the missing path still survives. One new discriminating test (test_admission_blocks_publication_exact_when_required_fixture_proof_is_missing) proves the BLOCKED side with a genuinely (not simulated) incomplete fixture and a genuinely VERIFIED bound context, isolating the missing-proof condition from every other admissibility reason. The FAIL side needed no new test: test_admission_reports_fail_not_blocked_when_verified_context_still_diverges (built in an earlier F-013 remediation round, unmodified here) already proves complete-proof-plus-divergence reports FAIL/ADMISSIBLE, and now doubles as this predicate's negative counterpart. Both directions were mutation-proven per governance protocol: disabling the new check (byte-restored after, hash-verified identical) turned the BLOCKED proofs red while the FAIL proof stayed green; forcing MISMATCH to also map to BLOCKED (byte-restored after, hash-verified identical) turned the FAIL proof red while the BLOCKED proofs stayed green.
